{{Quote|Let me help you--we'll make this scum pay!''"<br />"''You're a geologist, Eemi. Leave the fighting to the professionals!|Eemi and another archaeologist|<ref name="TOR:RitR">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Republic|Retribution in the Rift|Manaan}}</ref>}}
'''Eemi''' was a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] who lived on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. During the [[Invasion of Manaan]], Eemi and several other archaeologists were captured by the [[Syphus Collective]] in the [[Temple of the Progenitor]]. They were eventually rescued by the [[Alliance Commander]].<ref name="TOR:RitR" />
